descriptions: Optimised idle background checks to reduce memory and CPU usage — animation state and gun style syncing now reuse cached data and skip work when it isn't needed, so memory no longer appears to climb in resmon.
Gun style syncing no longer searches the full animation list for nearby armed players every few seconds.
Fixed player data (group membership and sync cooldowns) not being cleaned up when a player disconnects.
Fixed re-inviting a group member adding them to the group twice.
